description: Quote.Trade is a crypto dark-pool DEX that offers private fill-or-kill execution, streaming liquidity, and stablecoin-settled long and short market exposure. It combines off-chain private execution with publicly verifiable funding, balances, positions, and withdrawals on blockchain infrastructure.
summary: Quote.Trade exposes a REST API at `https://app.quote.trade/api` with a public OpenAPI schema, a WebSocket API at `wss://app.quote.trade`, and a hosted public MCP endpoint at `https://quote.trade/mcp`; private REST and private MCP actions use Quote.Trade-issued API credentials, while the MCP endpoint itself is publicly reachable.
